findings.title: Fallback locale YAML is never loaded outside set_locale
findings.body: The new fallback chain (requested locale, then SiteSetting.default_locale, then :en) only works if those locale files have been loaded into the backend. On-demand loading still only calls load_locale for I18n.config.locale inside I18n.translate, and the new I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! is invoked only from ApplicationController#set_locale. Processes that never hit that filter — Sidekiq workers, mailers, rake tasks, the console — therefore never load the site-default or English YAML. A job that does I18n.with_locale(user.effective_locale) and translates will load only that user's locale; missing keys will not fall back to the site language or English even though the yml files define them. Calls with an explicit locale: option have the same gap, because translate preloads config.locale rather than the locale actually being resolved. Argument-less I18n.t results are also frozen into the 300-entry LRU. The default i18n missing-translation handler returns a "translation missing: ..." string, so one early lookup in a job process caches that string and later lookups never retry after a locale file is loaded. Fallback loading has to happen on the translate path for the locale being resolved, not only in the controller filter.

findings.title: Translation LRU key ignores the fallback locale
findings.body: Argument-less translations are cached under "#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}" only. This change makes the resolved string also depend on SiteSetting.default_locale, because a key missing from the current locale is filled from the site default (then English) and that resolved string is what gets stored. default_locale is an admin setting that updates in-process without a restart, and nothing here includes the fallback locale in the cache key or clears @cache when it changes (I18n.reload! would clear it, but setting updates do not call that). Hot no-arg keys stay in the 300-entry LRU indefinitely, so after the default locale changes, users missing those keys keep seeing strings from the previous default locale until the worker is restarted.

findings.title: No coverage for fallback order or on-demand loading
findings.body: The custom chain [requested locale, SiteSetting.default_locale, :en] and the ensure_loaded! hook ship with no specs. Nothing asserts that a missing key resolves to the site locale before English, that the fallback YAML is actually loaded before lookup, or that translations outside ApplicationController#set_locale (jobs, mailers, I18n.with_locale) fall back at all. Those non-request paths are exactly where fallback files are not loaded, so the failure would not be caught before merge.
